oliver_devsec: Heads-up: registry scanner found a GCR token inside a public Docker image layer for image gcr.io/redwood-public/tooling:2.1. It looks like an ARG used during build got left in /app/.build-meta/token.txt.

maya_registry: which token exactly? service account or CI token?

oliver_devsec: token format suggests a short-lived OAuth token for service-account:sa-builder@proj-redwood. It's valid but was embedded into the image that is public.

grant_build: ugh, the Dockerfile uses `ARG BUILDER_TOKEN` and we accidentally populated it during image build on the public CI runner. We should never inject tokens as build args.

ci-bot: [automated] Created ticket S-5620: "Rotate exposed GCR token and rebuild public images" assigned to registry and build teams. https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/S-5620

security-bot: [automated] Quick action: revoking the token now and starting a scan for other public images containing 'token=' or 'oauth2'.

maya_registry: token revoked. Also marked the image vulnerable and unlisted the public tag. Will push a sanitized rebuild.

grant_build: immediate fix PR: update Dockerfiles to use `--secret` mounting or use ephemeral builder role via Workload Identity; remove ARG usage. PR: https://github.com/redwood/tooling/pull/501. Also adding linter rule to fail builds if ARG contains 'TOKEN' or 'KEY'.

oliver_devsec: checklist for teams: 1) rotate any tokens that match the revoked SA 2) rebuild any public images pushed in March 2026 3) run `registry-scan --public --pattern token` across gcr.io/* 4) add build-time secret handling docs.

ci-bot: [automated] Registry quick-scan found 2 more public images with potential secrets in layers (both from legacy-builders). Creating follow-ups under S-5620.

maya_registry: will quarantine the flagged images and request re-push after sanitization. Also enabling a pre-publish hook to scan layers for credential patterns.

grant_build: for the record, internal note: don't use ARG for secrets, use buildkit secrets or side-channel secrets API. We'll run a retro and update templates.

oliver_devsec: drafting short advisory: 24h rotation and rebuild, 72h full registry sweep, 7d retro from build infra. Post any image SHAs to S-5620.

maya_registry: done: token revoked, public tag removed, rebuild queued. Keep monitoring.

security-bot: [automated] Full registry scan completed: 0 public tokens remaining after quarantine; 5 private images flagged for manual review. See S-5620 for details.

oliver_devsec: closing slack thread, follow-ups in S-5620. If you see other build-time secrets leaks DM me. :rotating_light:
